## Terms

### Capacity Testing

- **Capacity Testing** · self — Capacity testing measures whether an application and its database remain responsive and stable as demand rises, using throughput, latency, errors, and resource use to identify the sustainable operating boundary. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/resources/basics/load-testing
